791: def general_copy(dst: TorchTensor, dst_indices: Tuple[slice],
792:                  src: TorchTensor, src_indices: Tuple[slice]):
793:     """Launch a general asynchronous copy between two tensors.
794:     It is equivalent to `dst[dst_indices] = src[src_indices]` in numpy syntax.
795:     The copy is asynchronous. To wait for the copy to complete, you need to call
796:     >>> env.disk.synchronize()
797:     >>> torch.cuda.synchronize()
798:     """

831:     elif src.device.device_type == DeviceType.DISK:
832:         # The tensor is on the disk, dispatch to copy threads for asynchronous copy
833:         src.device.submit_copy(dst, dst_indices, src, src_indices)
834:     elif dst.device.device_type == DeviceType.DISK:
835:         # The tensor is on the disk, dispatch to copy threads for asynchronous copy
836:         dst.device.submit_copy(dst, dst_indices, src, src_indices)
837:     elif (src.device.device_type == DeviceType.CUDA and
838:           dst.device.device_type == DeviceType.CPU and
839:           not dst.data.is_pinned() and src.shape[0] > 1):
840:         # The cpu tensor is not pinned, dispatch to copy threads and use pin_memory
841:         # as a relay
842:         global_disk_device.submit_copy(dst, dst_indices, src, src_indices)
843:     elif (src.device.device_type == DeviceType.CPU and
844:           dst.device.device_type == DeviceType.CUDA and
845:           not src.data.is_pinned()):
846:         # The cpu tensor is not pinned, use pin_memory as a relay
847:         src = src.data[src_indices] if src_indices else src.data
848:         dst = dst.data[dst_indices] if dst_indices else dst.data
849:         src = src.pin_memory()
850:         dst.copy_(src, non_blocking=True)
851:     else:
852:         # The normal path
853:         src = src.data[src_indices] if src_indices else src.data
854:         dst = dst.data[dst_indices] if dst_indices else dst.data
855:         dst.copy_(src, non_blocking=True)

878: def copy_worker_func(queue, cuda_id):
879:     """The copy worker thread."""
880:     torch.cuda.set_device(cuda_id)
881: 
882:     cpu_buf = torch.empty((1 * GB,), dtype=torch.float16, pin_memory=True)
883:     copy_stream = torch.cuda.Stream()
884: 
885:     with torch.cuda.stream(copy_stream):
886:         while True:
887:             item = queue.get()
888:             if item is None:
889:                 queue.task_done()
890:                 return
891: 
892:             dst, dst_indices, src, src_indices = item
893:             src_data = map_to_torch_tensor(src, src_indices)
894:             dst_data = map_to_torch_tensor(dst, dst_indices)
895: 
896:             if (src.device.device_type == DeviceType.CUDA or
897:                 dst.device.device_type == DeviceType.CUDA):
898:                 # Use a pinned cpu buffer as a relay
899:                 size = np.prod(src_data.shape)
900:                 tmp_cpu_buf = cpu_buf[:size].view(src_data.shape)
901:                 tmp_cpu_buf.copy_(src_data)
902:                 dst_data.copy_(tmp_cpu_buf)
903:             else:
904:                 dst_data.copy_(src_data)
905: 
906:             queue.task_done()
